name: Gadis 1 Milyar Rupiah
source:
Sevin thought that everything in this world was against him. He was surrounded by trouble all the time. One day, another problem was added to his already miserable life when he found a girl fainted on the street.

[From [url=http://renai.us/game/1brg.shtml]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
